commit_message: Seed two-level logic-audit and GUI-exercise beads

nodes.title: Two-level checks: logic audit then GUI exercise
nodes.description: Replace the single scrape-click-oracle loop with a logic audit of the UI code, then a click walk over the buttons that audit associated with actions. Accessibility off skips the click walk. Spec: openspec/changes/add-two-level-checks/.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: bd ready shows no open children under this epic once the simulator logic audit and GUI exercise beads are closed. Live seat remains a separate child.

nodes.title: Logic-audit fixture model
nodes.description: sim/fixtures/logic/ and sim/logic_audit.py load role, name, enabled, action, closes, colors, font size, clip, scroll parent, and the accessibility flag. No clicks.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: python3 sim/logic_audit.py --dump sim/fixtures/logic/readable.json prints those fields and exits 0.

nodes.title: Fail enabled buttons that have no action
nodes.description: Enabled button-role controls need an action binding. Disabled buttons are exempt and are not put on the action map.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: An enabled button with no action writes SARIF logic/button-without-action. A disabled button with no action does not.

nodes.title: Fail a close control that does not hide the window
nodes.description: Close, Close window, Close panel, ×, ✕, or objectName close/dismiss must be enabled and bound to close/hide/quit. This check does not click.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: Disabled Close and Close-with-a-non-close-action write logic/close-does-not-close. An enabled Close that hides the panel does not.

nodes.title: Check text contrast, size, and scroll
nodes.description: sim/readability.py: WCAG 2.2 AA on literal colors, warning for unresolved theme colors, explicit font below 12px or 9pt fails, clipped body text needs a Flickable or ScrollView. Button labels may elide.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover logic/text-contrast, a passing 4.5:1 pair, warning logic/text-color-unresolved that still passes CTRF, logic/text-too-small, omitted size, logic/text-not-scrollable, a scroll parent, and an exempt button label.

nodes.title: Accessibility gate for GUI exercise
nodes.description: Gate fails when accessibility is off or an enabled button lacks a role and non-empty name. The gate result is the only full skip of level 2.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: accessibility false writes logic/a11y-disabled. A nameless enabled button writes logic/a11y-marker-missing. Named buttons with accessibility on pass the gate.

nodes.title: Logic-audit CTRF, JUnit, and SARIF
nodes.description: Write sim/out/logic/ctrf.json, junit.xml, and findings.sarif. Test name logic-audit. No sequence.jsonl.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: The three report files exist, JUnit matches the CTRF status, and the logic run writes no click sequence.

nodes.title: Click only buttons associated with an action
nodes.description: sim/exercise.py clicks each action-map entry once via the fixture transition. It does not click a button with no action and does not use a recorded name list.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: A two-button map produces one click per name. A third enabled button with no action is absent from sequence.jsonl.

nodes.title: Skip GUI exercise when the accessibility gate fails
nodes.description: A failed accessibility gate writes a skipped exercise result and performs no click.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: python3 sim/exercise.py on an accessibility-off fixture writes CTRF status skipped and an empty sequence.

nodes.title: Fail exercise on crash or a close that stays open
nodes.description: Reuse the JSONL crash oracle. Clicking an associated close control fails exercise/close-still-open when the panel stays mapped.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: --inject-crash writes oracle/crash-log and fails CTRF. A stay-open close writes exercise/close-still-open. A hiding close does not.

nodes.title: Exercise CTRF, JUnit, SARIF, and sequence
nodes.description: Write sim/out/exercise/ separate from sim/out/logic/. Test name gui-exercise. Include sequence.jsonl.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: Exercise and logic CTRF test names differ, and the exercise sequence log exists after a click run.

nodes.title: Live seat: skip on an empty tree, else click associated buttons
nodes.description: Nested Hyprland only. An empty AT-SPI tree fails logic/a11y-disabled and injects nothing. Otherwise click associated buttons, PNG per click, and fail if close leaves the window mapped. Do not inject into the host seat.
nodes.acceptance_criteria: Accessibility-off app: no actuator events and skipped exercise. Gated app: one click per associated button, close unmaps, host seat untouched.
